english_prompt_summary: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: GitHub README product workflow explainer for AheadSubs. Create a precise, polished wide technical infographic, white/light slate background, flat crisp typography, navy text, teal and amber highlights. No people, no scenic illustration. Title: AheadSubs. Subtitle: Read ahead. Transcribe. Translate. Stay in sync. Four cards: PLAYER (PotPlayer · mpv, Playback position); AUDIO LOOK-AHEAD (Bounded audio buffer, Speech segments); TRANSCRIBE + TRANSLATE (Local models, Cloud APIs); TIMED SUBTITLES (Original media timestamps, SRT + reusable cache). Return arrow: Load / refresh subtitles. Media timeline: PLAYHEAD, Already Played, READ-AHEAD WINDOW, Subtitle Cue 1/2/3. Footer: CLI + HTTP API for integrations. Legible at 1100px, no zero-latency claims, no MCP logo.
